_about: GS1 pack codes (workplan step 21). Run by tests/unit-gs1.mjs (src/gs1.js) and rxpos_flutter/test/rules/gs1_test.dart (lib/core/rules/gs1.dart). \u001d is GS, the separator a scanner sends after a variable-length field. GTINs used: 4006381333931 (a published EAN-13 example) and 09506000134352 (GS1's own documentation example).

parse.name: a scanner with GS: product, expiry, batch, then serial
no GS sent, the usual order (batch last): still read
serial first, then expiry and batch
the printed text, a day of 00 = the month's last day
a scanner that types <GS> as text
